name: quackhole
description: Query a DuckDB behind NAT from a browser or another DuckDB, over an encrypted peer-to-peer connection

comments.version: Derived from crates/Cargo.toml by build.mjs, because bin/quackhole.js resolves the release tag it downloads from it. See docs/UPDATING.md.
comments.@duckdb/node-api: Pinned, not ranged. Its version() is v1.5.5, which is the duckdb_version the extension is built against -- so the ABI match the old shell script spent 60 lines detecting is true by construction. A range would let that come apart on an install.
comments.playwright: Only npm/test/scratch.mjs needs it, and CI never runs it: it wants a live relay and a native server.
